evidence.quoted_text:
require(result["rc"] not in (0, None),
            "interrupted switch unexpectedly returned success")
evidence.reason: The interruption proof at line 1306 only excludes success/None, so a different nonzero failure (for example rc 1) can satisfy it even if the injected SIGKILL never occurred. The journal/service/timer checks alone do not prove the switch was terminated at the install hook. The same file's recover_kill_phase explicitly requires rc == -9 at line 1342, confirming the intended signal-exit check for injected kills. Requiring the expected signal status is a routine correctness fix to the proof, not a new requirement.
